summary: Bounded source-owner recovery found no authoritative non-truncated José V11 bytes that can satisfy the immutable 69235-byte / SHA-256 gate. The material directory contains only the known corrupt gzip+base64 blob. Git history for that path has exactly one introducing commit (158357fe4e1cb672e4574d9ebe6f317b9418a30f), and the parent commit has no file at that path. PACK.json and LAST_RETURN.json preserve the expected raw identity and design decisions but not a second copy of the bytes. No bytes were synthesized, normalized or replaced.

unresolved: A materially new authoritative byte source outside the currently durable workstream is required before exact José V11 recovery can proceed.
Reviewable candidate publication must remain dependency-blocked while exact source identity is unavailable.
truth_boundary: SOURCE_DEBT. This return proves absence within the bounded durable workstream/history checked here; it does not prove the original V11 bytes never existed elsewhere.
